actions.description: Create a Deepforge realm using the faction picker.
Transfer 100 ore to the fairies and request a two-turn truce.
Launch the protected passage and move the commander into garrison range.
Reload the production page and resume the saved active passage.
Import the exported active profile through its file input.
Finish the passage by moving the commander to the eastern exit.
Wait for the treaty to expire, then fund an undead alliance.
Launch the hostile grove battle with the funded allied reinforcement.
Command the persistent detachment through the ordinary roster, attacks, movement and emplacement controls.

definition.title: Capture Ashwing Grove
definition.briefing: The Court guards the last unburned timber between Hearth and the eastern roads. Its wardens prefer an agreement that keeps armies out of the grove, but will fight anyone cutting a new military road. Hold the wooded clearing and protect the defenders from attacks along both trade paths. Defeat its 3 defenders with the persistent detachment.
definition.failureText: The detachment could not complete its mission.

objectives.text: Survive the counterattack and eliminate its garrison.
